hospitals.name: Apollo Athenaa Women's Cancer Centre
hospitals.bio: Apollo Athenaa Women’s Cancer Centre is a small, purpose-built floor in Delhi NCR — about fifty beds, opened in 2025, sitting inside the Apollo system’s JCI and NABH frame. It is not a general hospital. Radiation here is planned around breast and gynaecological work, with IMRT, SBRT, SRS and brachytherapy when those techniques spare what surgery would take. A travelling patient should only land here if the tumour actually belongs on a women’s-cancer list.

hospitals.name: Indraprastha Apollo Hospital
hospitals.bio: Indraprastha Apollo Hospital has been on the Delhi ring since 1996: 710 beds, JCI and NABH, a radiation floor used to second opinions from the Gulf and East Africa. Senior consultants here have been contouring longer than some linacs have existed. IGRT, SRS and SBRT are on the list when the indication is honest. The international ward already knows how to hold a companion through a six-week course.

hospitals.name: Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
hospitals.bio: Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills has been a Hyderabad landmark since 1988: 550 beds, JCI and NABH, a radiation department directed by a consultant whose name is asked for across Telangana. IMRT, IGRT, SRS and SBRT are everyday. Brachytherapy fellowship sits on the same floor. Fly to Hyderabad for that named list, not for a city you have never seen. Peer review before the ticket.

hospitals.name: Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road
hospitals.bio: Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road is a 250-bed JCI campus in Bengaluru, open since 2007. Radiation oncology here is a consultant bench: IMRT, IGRT, SRS, SBRT, CyberKnife and brachytherapy depending on who you are matched to. South India Today prizes do not book a course; a peer-reviewed plan does. English-first coordinators, Kannada and Hindi on the ward, a date after records.

hospitals.name: Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai
hospitals.bio: Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai opened in 2016: 500 beds, JCI and NABH, a radiation list that already includes IMRT, IGRT, SRS and SBRT. Navi Mumbai is the Mumbai tab for a reason — same city cluster, a campus used to international second opinions. Consultants here will not invent a stereotactic indication to shorten a hotel stay. Video first; a date if the plan is theirs.

hospitals.name: Apollo Proton Cancer Centre
hospitals.bio: Apollo Proton Cancer Centre in Chennai opened in 2019 with 150 beds and a proton gantry that is the reason most families fly this far. JCI and NABH are current. Radiation here is protons when the Bragg peak is the clinical argument, and photons when it is not. Neuro-oncology sits on the same campus. Velora will not sell a proton course that IMRT could have done at home.

hospitals.name: Artemis Hospital
hospitals.bio: Artemis Hospital in Gurugram is an 800-bed JCI campus from 2007 with a CyberKnife centre that already has a weekly list. Radiation oncology here is teletherapy, brachytherapy and image-guided work against scans that open, not against a three-day hotel package. DHA sits beside NABH for families used to Gulf paperwork. You meet the named consultant on camera; a date follows only if the machine matches the target.

hospitals.name: BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital
hospitals.bio: BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital is a 700-bed house in central Delhi with a radiation department that has been rebuilt more than once since 1959. JCI, NABH and NABL are current. The floor treats a wide list — head and neck, breast, thorax, GI, sarcoma, gynaecology, children — which is what you want from a city campus, not a boutique. Named consultants, peer-reviewed plans, a desk that answers.

hospitals.name: Fortis Memorial Research Institute
hospitals.bio: Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurugram is a thousand-bed JCI campus that opened in 2013. Radiation oncology is a principal-director department: SBRT, SRS, IMRT, IORT and brachytherapy on the same floor as physics. NABL covers the labs you will actually need mid-course. International patients get the same tumour-board slot as anyone walking in from Golf Course Road.

hospitals.name: Fortis Hospital, Noida
hospitals.bio: Fortis Hospital, Noida is a 236-bed JCI campus east of the Yamuna, running since 2004. Radiation oncology is a working department — 3D-CRT, IMRT, IGRT — with NABL labs on site. Noida is the right city when the named consultant is here, not because it is cheaper than Gurugram. English on the ward; a discharge note to the oncologist you already know at home.

hospitals.name: Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh
hospitals.bio: Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh is a 262-bed North Delhi campus from 2010, JCI and NABH, with a radiation HOD whose SBRT training includes Memorial Sloan Kettering. IMRT, IGRT and stereotactic body work are on the list. Families who already have lodging in North Delhi should not be sent to Gurugram for the same machine. The dossier names the consultant before it names the hotel.

hospitals.name: Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai
hospitals.bio: Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai is a thousand-bed JCI campus from 1999, NABL labs included. Radiation oncology is a high-volume South Indian list: IMRT, SBRT, brachytherapy, consultants who have been contouring for decades. Chromepet is not a tourist address; it is a campus with ICU and an international desk. Come for the named specialist. Stay for the fractions they actually prescribe.

hospitals.name: Gleneagles Hospitals, Bengaluru
hospitals.bio: Gleneagles Hospitals, Bengaluru is a JCI and NABH radiation house in the city, with a senior consultant in charge of the list. IMRT, SBRT and brachytherapy are the daily grammar. Bengaluru is useful when the named oncologist is here and the imaging you already have will open. If the case belongs at a proton centre in Chennai, that is the first sentence — not a polite afterthought.

hospitals.name: Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket
hospitals.bio: Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket is a 500-bed JCI campus in South Delhi, open since 2006. Radiation here includes a proton-trained principal director and a list that still does everyday IMRT. Saket is useful when you want tumour board, physics and a hotel that is a short car ride, not a second city. Records first; a date after the named oncologist has seen them.

hospitals.name: Medanta - The Medicity
hospitals.bio: Medanta — The Medicity sits on the Gurugram side of Delhi NCR: a 1,600-bed house that opened in 2009 and runs radiation like a department, not a side list. JCI, NABH and NABL are on the wall. The useful fact for a travelling patient is the named radiation team — linac, stereotactic and brachytherapy already booked every week — and an international desk that meets night landings. If Gurugram is the wrong campus for the constraint, the dossier should say so before you fly.

hospitals.name: Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai
hospitals.bio: Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai is a 310-bed campus from 2023, already inside JCI and NABH. Radiation oncology is young as a building and staffed as a department — IMRT, IGRT, 3D-CRT on a weekly linac list. For a travelling patient the test is the named consultant, not the opening year. If the case needs protons or a CyberKnife that is not on this floor, the dossier should send you elsewhere.

hospitals.name: MGM Healthcare, Chennai
hospitals.bio: MGM Healthcare, Chennai is a 400-bed JCI campus from 2016. Radiation oncology here includes senior consultants with Tata Memorial and Princess Margaret time — SBRT for liver and spine, IMRT, brachytherapy. ASTRO and ESTRO talks do not replace a plan you can read. International patients get the same slot. If Chennai photons are enough, nobody should be sent up the road for protons.

hospitals.name: Paras Hospitals, Gurugram
hospitals.bio: Paras Hospitals, Gurugram is a 300-bed JCI house from 2006. Radiation is a group-director department: IMRT, IGRT, 3D-CRT, with consultants who still contour their own cases. It is a quieter Gurugram campus than the thousand-bed neighbours — useful when you want a named specialist and a ward that is not a concourse. Peer review before the ticket; interruption protocol on file.

hospitals.name: Rela Hospital
hospitals.bio: Rela Hospital in Chennai is a 450-bed JCI campus from 2018, with NABL and a DHA line for Gulf families. Radiation oncology is a head-of-department floor: EBRT, IMRT, SBRT, brachytherapy, a visiting CyberKnife list when the indication is real. It is a newer house with consultants who trained in older ones. Records on camera first; a date if Chromepet is the right city.

hospitals.name: Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad
hospitals.bio: Sarvodaya Hospital in Faridabad is a 450-bed JCI campus that has been treating since 1991. Radiation oncology here includes a brain-tumour fellowship alumna and an HOD who still does SRS and SBRT. Faridabad is Delhi NCR: same airport corridor, a different bed. Come for the named consultant, not for a brand you saw in a brochure. English, Hindi, and a letter home after the last fraction.

hospitals.name: Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City
hospitals.bio: Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City is the group’s large Hyderabad campus — two thousand beds in a JCI frame, radiation led by consultants who still do CyberKnife, SRS, SBRT and IORT. A PhD on the senior list does not replace physics QA. HITEC City is for patients whose named oncologist is here. English, Telugu, Hindi; a discharge letter after the last fraction; no tourist radiosurgery.

hospitals.name: Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad
hospitals.bio: Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad is the 1,000-bed twin of the group’s Hyderabad practice, JCI and NABH, with radiation consultants who live on SRS, SBRT and brachytherapy. CyberKnife sits on the same map. Secunderabad is not a compromise campus; it is where those named oncologists contour. If Somajiguda is the right floor instead, the dossier should say so in the first paragraph.

hospitals.name: Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda
hospitals.bio: Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda is a 620-bed Hyderabad campus in a group that has treated since 1989. JCI, NABH, NABL. Radiation oncology here includes MD Anderson IGRT training, SRS, SBRT and a RapidArc list that already runs weekly. Somajiguda is central Hyderabad — useful when the consultant is on this campus, not Secunderabad. A travelling patient meets them on camera. A date follows the DVH, not the hotel rate.

hospitals.name: Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket
hospitals.bio: Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket is the Saket twin of Max’s South Delhi practice, JCI from 2013. Surgical oncology here shares a city with Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket — useful when the named surgeon contours on this campus, not the neighbour. Records first; a date after they have seen them.

hospitals.name: Wockhardt Hospital, Mumbai
hospitals.bio: Wockhardt Hospital, Mumbai is a JCI and NABH house that has treated since 1991. Surgical oncology here is a named-surgeon list, not a weekend package. Mumbai is the city when the consultant is on this floor. English, Hindi, Marathi; records on camera first.

hospitals.name: Fortis Escorts Heart Institute
hospitals.bio: Fortis Escorts Heart Institute sits in Delhi NCR: a JCI campus from 1988, better known for cardiac work and now carrying named cancer surgeons on Velora’s surgical-oncology list. Come for the consultant, not the historic heart brand. Peer review before the ticket.

hospitals.name: Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai
hospitals.bio: Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai is a JCI and NABH radiation-and-surgery house in the city, open since 2008. Surgical oncology is a working list: GI, breast, thoracic depending on who you are matched to. If the case belongs at a different Mumbai campus, the dossier should say so first.

hospitals.name: Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram
hospitals.bio: Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram is a Medical Oncology campus in Delhi NCR, India on Velora’s list. It opened in 2020. JCI · NABH · NABL accreditation is current. Named medical oncologists write chemotherapy, immunotherapy and targeted protocols here; radiation and surgery sit on the same map when the case needs both. Records on camera first; a date if Delhi NCR is the right city.
